number-theory.label: Midterm review
number-theory.title: From Euclid to finite fields
number-theory.description: Cumulative practice through finite-fields Lecture 2: integers, continued fractions, congruences, arithmetic functions, valuations, primes, bases, and quadratic extensions. Two optional enrichment problems follow.
number-theory.details: 16 core problems + 2 optional · 160 practice points · 5–7 hours

number-theory.label: Problem Set 1
number-theory.title: Euclid and the architecture of the integers
number-theory.description: Divisibility, greatest common divisors, Bézout identities, prime factorization, and the infinitude of primes.

number-theory.label: Week 2
number-theory.title: Division, primes, and finite continued fractions
number-theory.description: Turn Euclidean calculations, a sieve, and finite continued fractions into proofs. Test divisibility claims with counterexamples.

number-theory.label: Problem Set 3
number-theory.title: Totients, divisor sums, and exact periods
number-theory.description: Extended Euclid and Euler's theorem lead into multiplicative functions, Möbius inversion, necklace counts, and squarefree integers.

number-theory.label: Problem Set 4 · Optional enrichment
number-theory.title: Orders, interpolation, and Fourier inversion
number-theory.description: Invert counts on posets, subsets, and partitions, then recover polynomial coefficients at roots of unity and explore cyclic convolution.

number-theory.label: Topic problem set
number-theory.title: Multiplicative functions
number-theory.description: Prime-power values, divisor functions, totients, convolution, Möbius cancellation, and counting applications.

number-theory.label: Topic problem set
number-theory.title: Valuations, primes, and p-adic distance
number-theory.description: Factorial and binomial valuations, Chebyshev growth bounds, and a first introduction to p-adic distance, the ultrametric inequality, and convergence.

number-theory.label: Weekly quiz collection
number-theory.title: Ten checkpoints from Euclid to primes
number-theory.description: Short, self-contained quizzes following the course sequence, with space to write calculations and proofs.

probability-statistics.label: Midterm review
probability-statistics.title: Cumulative review through continuous distributions
probability-statistics.description: Timed practice in counting, conditioning, dependent indicators, discrete and continuous laws, coupon collection, density calculations, and Chebyshev's inequality.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 1
probability-statistics.title: The geometry of events
probability-statistics.description: Set notation, complements, De Morgan’s laws, Venn diagrams, and inclusion–exclusion. No probability background assumed.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 2
probability-statistics.title: Counting, events, and shared birthdays
probability-statistics.description: Probability spaces, permutations, combinations, binomial identities, inclusion–exclusion, and the birthday paradox.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 3
probability-statistics.title: Counting, collisions, and derangements
probability-statistics.description: Discrete probability spaces, poker and word counts, birthday bounds, collision patterns, and the hat-check problem.

probability-statistics.label: Problem Set 4
probability-statistics.title: Distributions, tails, and coupon collection
probability-statistics.description: Discrete and continuous laws, coupon completion deadlines, signed tail areas, a capped carnival prize, and a highest-bid pizza auction.
probability-statistics.details: 8 core problems + challenge · 100 points · About 4 hours

probability-statistics.label: Class quiz
probability-statistics.title: Conditional probability and Bayes’ rule
probability-statistics.description: Finite probability spaces, conditioning from a table, total probability, and a guided solution to Monty Hall.

probability-statistics.label: Class quiz
probability-statistics.title: Birthdays, derangements, and a little calculus
probability-statistics.description: The series and approximations behind birthday collisions and derangements, followed by a Bayes’ rule problem.

probability-statistics.label: Class quiz
probability-statistics.title: Expectation, variance, and discrete distributions
probability-statistics.description: Discrete probability spaces, moments, Bernoulli indicators, binomial counts, and geometric waiting times.

probability-statistics.label: Class quiz
probability-statistics.title: Discrete and continuous distributions
probability-statistics.description: Bernoulli, binomial, geometric, Poisson, exponential, and uniform distributions, with a guided coupon-collector problem.

probability-statistics.label: Weekly quiz collection
probability-statistics.title: Ten checkpoints from sets to inference
probability-statistics.description: Short quizzes following the course from events and distributions through estimation and Bayesian inference, with writing space.
